Signatures untouched — `compute(net, country)` and `export_month(invoices, year, month, outdir)` are byte-identical in shape.

## Verification

- `python3 -m pytest -q` → **10 passed** (was 1).
- Fixture run (2026-10): 95 CSV rows, 25 stderr skip lines, summary `CHF 20 10754.55` / `EUR 75 43418.43` / `skipped 25`, totals reconciling cent-for-cent against the CSV.
- Half-even proven by test: `5.50 @ 19%` → `1.045` → **1.04**, not 1.05.

## Notes

- `docs/notes/draft.md` conflicts with the spec on four points (7.7% CH, comma delimiter, JSON summary, half-up rounding). I followed the spec on all four.
- `export_month` returns a `Path` (docstring says "the path of the file written"); say the word if you want a `str` instead.
- I deleted the `__pycache__`/`.pytest_cache` artifacts my runs created. The repo has no `.gitignore`, so `export/__pycache__` will reappear on every run — worth adding one, but I left that alone as it's outside the request.
